detail:
One rule, learned six times: a CI gate must STATE the environment it needs rather than inherit it, and must not require an optional dependency to load code that does not use it. Each instance was green on a laptop and red (or worse, silent) on a runner. (1) signature-parity loaded host-pure signature exports from the React Native bundle, which imported webdriverio at top level, in a job that installs no npm packages; it passed locally only because node_modules happened to exist. (2) sdk-backend-core pinned an exact deployment shape while the Python SDK falls back to GITHUB_SHA, which a GitHub runner always sets. (3) The worst, because it produced no red at all: windows-uia needed a self-hosted runner this repository has none of, yet ran on every push and skipped on the only event that can opt in, so native-backend-gates never concluded across 12 pushes. (4) A Linux SDK suite imported its own package by name while CI runs it by path from the repo root. (5) The Android host test curl'd junit with no verification, so a corrupt jar was cached and kotlinc blamed the newest test file. (6) Java and then Ruby repeated instance 2, surfacing only once SDK support tiers were abolished and their suites began gating.

Fixing these one at a time is how you reach six, so the guard now states the RULE for the ambient-identity family: if an SDK's production code reads an ambient code-identity variable, some test file in that SDK must neutralize it, by whatever idiom the ecosystem offers. Applying it found two further LATENT cases with nothing failing behind them, dotnet and node. Eight SDKs are covered.

The rule was wrong twice before its own controls caught it, and both times it failed QUIET. Marking Rust inline test modules as test files also excluded them from the source scan, so Rust stopped being checked and the covered set fell from eight to seven while the suite still reported OK. And matching the neutralization idiom alone was satisfied by an unrelated putenv of REPROIT_REPLAY in the PHP replay suite, so a file must now contain both the idiom and one of the variable names.

The checks are structural, in the spirit of check-harness-integrity.py: they cannot prove a gate is correct, they refuse the exact shapes that have already cost this project silently broken jobs. Seven cases, each with a negative control that fails on the parent and passes on the fix.
